name: Willow Dental — emergency booking
description: Explore a simpler appointment booking experience for a fictional clinic.

context.overview: Willow Dental is a fictional digital clinic management platform for managing appointments and front-desk coordination.
context.users: Front-desk staff help patients find appropriate appointments while coordinating clinician availability.
context.userProblems: Emergency appointment booking requires repeated entry and too many screens while a patient is waiting.
context.goals: Explore a simpler flow that makes available slots and the final booking clear.
constraints: Require patient name, contact and an available slot
Do not offer medical triage or diagnosis

suggestedPrompt: Create a three-step appointment booking flow for a dental clinic.
